notes.title: New unarmed animations and bugfixes.
notes.content:
Update 1.0.3.1 includes the following improvements:

- New unarmed animations. Now unarmed animations will not be similar to those with weapons. 
- Fixed a bug where sometimes mouse sensitivity did not work in first person view.

- The last zone phase will now shrink until the very end. 
- Fixed a bug with respawning when reconnecting to the server. 
- The loading screen is now shown for spectators too.

notes.title: Smaller maps, multiple modes and more dynamic gameplay!
notes.content:
Greetings peasants!

Since the player base in Peasant Royale is not yet big enough, the decision was made to switch to smaller maps, with a shorter interval between zone shrinkings.
This will create the right pace for a match with any number of players.
On average, the length of each game will be 5-6 minutes.
Servers will no longer shut down when a match ends,
so you can stay on the same server until the next game starts.

The looting system has also been improved and simplified. Now you just need to run over an armor item and it will automatically be put on if it is better than the one you are wearing.
Other items are also collected automatically.
Weapons that are located in the first 6 slots can be replaced by picking up another one.

Full list of changes in update 1.0.3.0:
- 4 new maps.
- Auto-pickup of items.
- Quick replacement of your current weapon with a new one.
- Changed intervals between zone shrinkings.
- 4 new game modes.
- Items now drop to the ground when killed.
- Weapons can now only be placed in the first 6 slots.
- Inventory improvements: right click to drop an item, double click to use it.
- Chests with loot.
- The catapult can be placed on any surface.
- Invert mouse setting.
- As well as other improvements and optimizations of game and netcode performance.

notes.title: Improved chasing system, buffed catapult and one-handed weapons.
notes.content:
Update 1.0.2.7 includes the following improvements:

- You can now sprint while attacking. This will help chase down archers and throwers.
- More convenient control of the catapult: now it can be rotated, and the trajectory of the projectile will also be shown.
- The catapult now penetrates armor.
- Improved animations for one-handed weapons.
- One-handed weapons deal more damage.
- Now you can get meat with any melee weapon.
- New meshes for arrows and catapults. They are now easier to spot when looting.
- Fixed a bug with the inability to close the menu in spectator mode.
- Animated crosshair.

notes.title: Spectator mode and armor changes.
notes.content:
Update 1.0.2.5 includes the following improvements:

- The area of the loot box has been increased - now you can strafe while looting.
- Added the ability to spectate players after death.
- Minor map improvements.
- Apron and jacket now cover the same area. You'll be protected even with just one of these.
- Armor of the same type no longer stacks in armor slots.
- Combos are now performed not by holding the left mouse button, but by clicking.
- Fixed bugs in the animation of the upward slash.

- Fixed a bug with item slots.

notes.title: Fight each other while you wait!
notes.content:
Update 1.0.2.2 includes:

- Players can now kill each other while waiting for a match to start.
- Improved server stability.
- The chat window has been reduced and now it does not go beyond the boundaries.
- Added tips of the day.
- VR plugins are disabled.
- The number of kills does not increase during the lobby.
- Reduced waiting time.
- Removed the limit of 16 players (which for some reason was in the engine by default)
